name: We Rock the Spectrum — Northern Kentucky
address: 331 Kenton Lands Rd, Suite 400, Erlanger, KY 41018
limitations: Public branch information; no on-site audit. Open play, private rentals and school field trips have different supervision and booking rules. The We Rock Care page both advertises care and says services are coming soon; care availability is unresolved. Field-trip footwear accommodations are not a blanket open-play exception. The social story’s visible socks instruction differs from stale extracted text; use current policies and confirm individual arrangements. Door widths, thresholds, parking-to-door continuity, equipment transfer/support procedures, toilet and changing facilities remain unverified. A calming room does not establish a quiet whole gym or guaranteed availability.
facts: The branch lists a calming room and a fine-motor, arts-and-crafts area. Room availability and individual sensory conditions need confirmation.
FINE MOTOR AND ARTS AND CRAFTS AREA
The gym lists swings, crash mats, a zip line, trampoline and climbing structure. This does not establish wheelchair access onto equipment or transfer assistance.
During open play, a parent or guardian must stay with the child at all times.
A PARENT OR GUARDIAN MUST ACCOMPANY THE CHILD DURING OPEN PLAY AT ALL TIMES.
The open-play page prohibits shoes on the gym floor and requires socks for adults and children. Ask the branch about any footwear support you need.
No Shoes are allowed on the gym floor. Socks are required for all adults and children.
Open-play hours change with private rentals and parties. Call 859-727-9787 or check the current weekly schedule before travelling.
Hours vary based on private rentals and birthday party reservations. Please check our appointment calendar above or call for more information.
PLEASE CALL OR CHECK SOCIAL MEDIA FOR THIS WEEK'S OPEN PLAY SCHEDULE

The private-rental/play-date offer is weekdays only, for up to 10 people, with one adult guest for every four children and booking two weeks ahead. These are the private-rental terms; field-trip supervision is different.
Weekdays only . Up to 10 people, with one adult guest required for every 4 children.
Must be booked two weeks advance.
Private rentals include the gym, art room and calming room, but no childcare. The party room is excluded, and private rentals/play dates cannot be used as birthday packages.
Includes use of gym, art room, and calming room.
Childcare is not included with private rentals. Party room is not included in private rentals and private facility rental/playdates cannot be used as birthday packages.

For school field trips, the branch offers shoe covers for purchase for adults unable to remove shoes and says it can accommodate children with leg braces or sensory issues. Arrange the needed accommodation; this contract does not establish the open-play exception.
We have shoe covers available for purchase for adults who are unable to remove their shoes and can make accommodations for children with leg braces and sensory issues.
School field trips require at least one non-staff adult for every three children. Gym staff help with the experience but are not in charge of the children’s care.

ADULT SUPERVISION: We require that there is at least 1 adult (non-staff member) for every 3 children on your field trip. Our staff is here to help provide our guests with a fun and safe experience, but are not in charge of the children's care.
The school field-trip form invites requests such as no music or hiding lobby snacks. A request is not confirmation that a particular arrangement will be provided.
If you have any requests, such as 'No Music', 'Hide lobby snack', or anything else you would like us to be aware of please let us know above.
The public field-trip option is limited to groups of 10 or fewer students, excludes Fridays and shares the gym with open play. A private field trip closes the gym to the public.
Public (This option is only available for groups with 10 or less students. This option is not available for Fridays. The gym will be open to the public for Open Play.
Private (the gym will be closed to the public.
For field trips, food and drinks must stay in the party room or lobby, outside the gym area.
FOOD & DRINKS: All food and drinks must remain in our party room or lobby, not the gym area.

The care page advertises respite, break-time and one-to-one attendant care but also says “Services Coming Soon!” Confirm whether care is currently offered; do not plan a drop-off based on the advertised service or prices.
We offer Respite , Break Time Care , and One-to-One Attendant Care .

For the care service whose availability remains unclear, the page specifies ages 3–13 and toilet-trained children, requires a parent conversion form and says the gym is not a licensed daycare. These restrictions are not stated as general open-play admission rules.
For children ages 3 to 13 years. Children must be potty trained.
A parent conversion form is required for both levels of service.
We Rock the Spectrum is not a licensed daycare facility.

name: Fei House
limitations: Public venue information with a separate community recommendation; no on-site audit. The current site uses Fei House and retains older KungBrew branding. Official photographs show front/side porch steps and an interior staircase, but do not establish whether another entrance or lift exists. Step-free arrival, door controls, upstairs access, toilet/changing layout, seating clearances and assistance remain unverified. Listed October/November 2026 tea events have already ended; their attendance limits and availability are not current session promises. No reuse licence was found for the photographer’s gallery; link to the originals.
facts: The venue places its specialty tea room upstairs and describes traditional low-floor seating there. Confirm an appropriate seat and route before booking; the page does not explain a lift or step-free upstairs connection.
Upstairs, guests can discover our specialty tea room and traditional low-floor seating for an immersive experience.
The ground floor has landscape and zodiac murals, and the café describes antique furnishings and décor throughout. This is visual-environment context, not a promise of low stimulation.
Inside, the ground floor features a breathtaking mural by Adam Lusso, capturing the tranquility of Asian landscapes alongside the twelve zodiac animals.
Every corner of our café is filled with antique furnishings and décor, each piece carrying its own unique story and cultural charm.
Published hours are Tuesday–Friday 7 a.m.–5 p.m. and Saturday–Sunday 7:30 a.m.–5 p.m., closed Mondays. Confirm holiday or event changes before travelling.
Operation Hours Monday​ Tuesday​ - Friday​ Saturday​ - Sunday​ Closed​ 7 AM-5 PM​​ 7:30 AM-5 PM​
The official site locates Fei House at 640 Main Street in Covington. Older event descriptions on the same site still use the Kung Brew name.
Fei House, 640 Main St, Covington, KY 41011, USA
Join us on the 2nd floor of Kung Brew

name: Wondercade
limitations: Public venue policies with separate historical visitor accounts; no on-site audit. Westwood location confirmed by the official address. Admission and age rules do not establish physical access to games. Entrance thresholds and controls, parking-to-door route, aisle widths, control heights, seating, toilets/changing facilities and quiet spaces remain unverified. No free companion admission or transfer assistance is established.
facts: Admission includes games set to free play and re-entry that day; visitors do not need quarters or tokens. The site says entry after 9 p.m. is adults only.
We are a free play arcade. No quarters or tokens, just admission.
Children under 12 need a responsible adult aged 18 or older admitted and playing alongside them. Under-18s are welcome before 9 p.m.; ages 18–20 may attend throughout opening hours.
Under 12 Require a responsible adult (18+) to be admitted and play alongside them Welcome before 9pm
Membership entry requires the membership card and matching ID. Membership covers one person; no companion admission is specified.
Present your membership card with matching ID for entry
The group-visit offer requires at least 10 people. The party offer adds exclusive use of the party room for two hours; its physical access is not described.
Exclusive access to Party Room for 2 hours
For visit arrangements, call 513-389-0000 or email wondercadecincy@gmail.com. The listed schedule is Wednesday–Friday 4 p.m.–midnight, Saturday 2 p.m.–midnight and Sunday 2–9 p.m.
